title: Introduction to Python Programming
description: Master the fundamentals of Python programming including variables, data structures, control flow, functions, and object-oriented concepts.
learning_outcomes: Write clean and idiomatic Python scripts
Implement custom functions and object-oriented classes
Manipulate strings, lists, dictionaries, and file I/O in Python

title: Data Structures and Algorithms in Python
description: Learn essential computer science algorithms, complexity analysis, and advanced data structures using Python.
learning_outcomes: Analyze asymptotic complexity using Big-O notation
Implement trees, graphs, heaps, and hash tables
Solve algorithmic problem solving tasks using dynamic programming

title: Mathematics and Statistics for Data Science
description: Comprehensive grounding in linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability, and inferential statistics for machine learning.
learning_outcomes: Compute matrix decompositions, eigenvalues, and gradient vectors
Apply probability distributions and hypothesis testing
Formulate statistical estimation problems

title: Relational Database Design and Advanced SQL
description: Hands-on guide to relational database modeling, indexing, query optimization, and complex window functions in SQL and PostgreSQL.
learning_outcomes: Design 3NF relational schemas and foreign keys
Author complex SQL queries with window functions and CTEs
Optimize query performance using indexes and execution plans

title: Applied Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn
description: Build end-to-end machine learning pipelines from feature engineering and model training to cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning.
learning_outcomes: Preprocess tabular data with encoders, scalers, and imputation
Train and evaluate linear models, random forests, and gradient boosting trees
Validate models with precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and cross-validation

title: Deep Learning and Neural Architectures with PyTorch
description: Master deep neural networks, backpropagation, convolutional networks, and recurrent architectures using PyTorch.
learning_outcomes: Construct custom PyTorch layers, loss functions, and training loops
Train convolutional networks for computer vision classification
Implement sequence models with embeddings and attention mechanisms

title: Natural Language Processing with Transformers & LLMs
description: Modern NLP leveraging self-attention, BERT, RoBERTa, HuggingFace transformers, and instruction tuning for LLMs.
learning_outcomes: Fine-tune transformer models with HuggingFace and LoRA
Build token classification and sequence tagging pipelines for skill extraction
Evaluate NLP models with exact span, token F1, and BLEU metrics

title: AWS Cloud Foundations and Core Services
description: Introductory guide to Amazon Web Services including compute, storage, networking, security, and cloud cost management.
learning_outcomes: Provision and configure EC2 virtual machines and S3 buckets
Set up VPC subnets, security groups, and internet gateways
Configure IAM roles and policies for secure cloud access

title: AWS Solutions Architect: Scalable Cloud Architecture
description: Design resilient, highly available, and decoupled multi-tier enterprise systems on AWS.
learning_outcomes: Architect elastic load-balanced and auto-scaled application tiers
Deploy relational (RDS) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) databases with read replicas
Implement event-driven workflows with SQS, SNS, and Lambda serverless

title: Containerization and Orchestration with Docker & Kubernetes
description: Package modern applications into reproducible Docker containers and deploy multi-node workloads on Kubernetes clusters.
learning_outcomes: Write multi-stage Dockerfiles and minimize container image footprint
Deploy Kubernetes pods, deployments, services, and ingress controllers
Configure configmaps, persistent volumes, and health probes

title: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment Pipelines
description: Automate build, test, lint, security scans, and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and modern CI/CD tooling.
learning_outcomes: Construct declarative CI/CD pipelines with branch triggers and caching
Automate testing, code quality checks, and container image publishing
Implement zero-downtime blue-green and canary deployment strategies

title: End-to-End MLOps: Production ML Engineering
description: Operationalize machine learning models with experiment tracking, model registry, automated pipelines, and drift monitoring.
learning_outcomes: Track experiments and artifacts with MLflow and weights & biases
Build production inference services using FastAPI and Docker
Monitor model performance, latency, and data drift in production

title: Modern Frontend Development with React and TypeScript
description: Create scalable, type-safe web applications using React components, hooks, state management, and modern TypeScript.
learning_outcomes: Build reactive UI components with React functional hooks
Leverage TypeScript for compile-time safety and typed API interfaces
Implement client-side routing, query caching, and state management

title: High-Performance REST APIs with Python and FastAPI
description: Develop, validate, document, and test asynchronous backend APIs using FastAPI and Pydantic.
learning_outcomes: Create asynchronous REST endpoints with path/query parameter validation
Define request/response schemas using Pydantic data models
Implement JWT authentication, middleware, and dependency injection

title: Big Data Engineering with Apache Spark & Distributed Systems
description: Process terabyte-scale datasets with PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL, partitioned storage formats, and distributed streaming.
learning_outcomes: Write distributed PySpark transformations and aggregations
Tune Spark jobs, partition sizing, and shuffle operations
Ingest and process streaming data with Structured Streaming and Kafka
